summary: Two fractal-reconcile tests run smaller on pull requests: idle_lookup_cost_is_flat_with_delivered_mail_and_pr_history seeds 2,500 delivered messages and 500 observations, then doubles them (was 10,000 and 2,000), and incremental_passes_write_what_full_passes_write runs seeds 1 to 4 (was 1 to 8), the fewest that reach every kind it checks. The daily run (ST_TEST_SCALE=full) keeps the full sizes and eight seeds. A scan of the idle history still fails the cost test at the smaller size.

replay.detail: Test only; no claim, replay or projection change.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: No wire, CLI or client change.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to run the full sizes and eight seeds on every pull request again.
